mapper.select: SELECT id, name, color, display_order, is_default FROM categories ORDER BY display_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO categories (name, color, display_order, is_default) VALUES (#{name}, #{color}, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(d.display_order), 0) + 1 FROM categories d), FALSE)
mapper.update: UPDATE categories SET name = #{name}, color = #{color}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
